detected_by: the worker itself, cross-checking git log HEAD against git log origin/tranche/15 before trusting a retro summary that returned 0 events since 2026-09-06
impact: The Epic 2 re-gate worker's isolated worktree was created at fe5ae6cd4a (the tranche/14 merge, pre-SD-35) rather than origin/tranche/15 HEAD 9995efa1b6 — 100+ commits behind, missing every Epic 1 and Epic 2 commit including the wrap-up fix cycle. A full verify.sh was launched and had run ~14 minutes against that tree before the discrepancy was caught; it would have gated the wrong content and reported a green Epic 2 that did not include Epic 2.
resolution: killed the in-flight gate, git fetch origin tranche/15 && git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD inside the worker's own worktree, relaunched the full gate at 9995efa1b6
summary: Epic 2 re-gate worker dispatched at a worktree base 100+ commits behind origin/tranche/15; caught before the gate result was believed

reason: git worktree remove refuses both: 'contains modified or untracked files, use --force to delete it'. Both carry 0 unmerged commits against origin/tranche/15, but --force destroys uncommitted content the standing rule protects, and no operator asked for it. Disk is not under pressure: 62% used, 562G available, well under scripts/reclaim.sh's pressure threshold.
revisit: Epic 7 bundle-closure epilogue, or the first cycle that sees the repo filesystem above the reclaim pressure threshold
summary: Epic 2 worktree sweep: 1 of 3 pruned, 2 retained because they hold uncommitted files and --force was not authorised
what: 2 of Epic 2's 3 sibling worktrees not pruned: wf_291be5c8-5f3-14 (base a542652c5e, AT-35-E2-005-DISPOSITION cycle 2) and wf_291be5c8-5f3-15 (base 8cc4ea1516, AT-35-E2-005-DISPOSITION cycle 1), 859M + 858M
